purpose: Machine-verifiable autonomous completion score for overnight validation and safe repair.
completion_rule: AUTONOMOUS_COMPLETE only when every scored gate is executed and passed on the exact final SHA/tree, the worktree is clean, receipt integrity passes, and no autonomous-safe blocker remains.
protected_gate_policy: These gates are never fabricated as passes. They remain WAITING_APPROVAL or EXTERNAL until explicitly completed. They do not reduce the autonomous engineering score, but production RELEASE APPROVED is forbidden until required protected gates are actually satisfied.
browser_policy: Use local Playwright first. Browserbase may be used only if already authorized and no incremental spend is required; otherwise stop for approval before paid usage.
snapshot_policy: Every validation run uses --update-snapshots=none. Never manufacture or promote visual baselines without explicit operator approval.
visual_lock: No intentional visual or visible-content changes without explicit operator approval.
